title: GEORGIA Roccabruna [LORA/ZImageTurbo]
description:
This LoRA does not depict a real person; it is a fictional creation.

Georgia Roccabruna belongs to the RoccaBruna family of Florence, and she learned color from the city before she learned it from a kit. 🏰🇮🇹 Sunsets on the Arno, painted faces in galleries, and family occasions full of careful dress made beauty feel like a language. She uses that language to help people look like the day they are actually having. The work stays on the surface on purpose, and she respects what it can do.

As a makeup artist the afternoon might be a soft daytime face or a stronger evening one for a celebration. 🎨✨ Brushes, light, and a clear question start every session: what should this person feel when they see the result? She does not erase a face. She edits with consent and stops when the person recognizes themselves, only brighter. 🌹 The room stays professional, towels clean, talk easy. Confidence is the deliverable. Glamour is only one of the routes.

After the last client, Georgi
